Article 10 — Dividends

Decisive treaty wording: 10 per cent ... 15 per cent.

Article 11 — Interest

Decisive treaty wording: not exceed 10 per cent ... shall be exempted from tax.

Article 12 — Royalties

Decisive treaty wording: 10 per cent ... 15 per cent.

Article 11(3) — Notwithstanding paragraph 2, interest shall be exempted from tax in the Contracting State in which it arises if it is derived and beneficially owned by the Government of the other Contracting State, including the Central Bank or a wholly government-owned financial institution, or by a resident of the other Contracting State in connection with a loan or credit guaranteed by that Government.
